title: Ink Drag
description: A giant word printed in wet black ink on cream letterpress paper: drag through it and the ink smears along your path, thick and soft when slow, thin streaks when fast. A few seconds after you stop, the sheen fades and the smear dries for good; set your own word or pull a fresh sheet.
intent: Type as matter: wet ink you push with a fingertip, with real body, sheen and a drying clock that makes every smear permanent.
